# Demo video — the narration, with real timings

*Generated by `npm run record:submission`. Each line starts at the time shown in the film in
`docs/demo/`; the times are written as the take happens, not planned in advance.*

The video is **narrated**: every line below is spoken, in a Gemini text-to-speech voice directed scene
by scene, and shown as a subtitle.

The runtime of the take this file describes is **4 min 50 s**.

Nothing in the picture is staged or cut. The Hindi report is a recorded sample played into a real
microphone stream, and it is audible in the film; the register page is a drawn sample with one row
that does not add up. Google sign-in is shown up to Google’s own screen — Google does not complete a
sign-in inside an automated browser — and each role after it is an operator session, labelled
“operator · role” on screen and on the audit trail. The Gemini calls, the commit, the ticket and the
receipt all happen against the running deployment while the camera is on.
